🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation but leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5: Narrow, 4/5 Technology), and a major divergence among large caps (AAPL, MSFT, META, ORCL showing 1W vs 1M sign mismatch) — supports a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +1.68%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.30% | 1M: -1.66%) RECOVERY. Technology strong on winners: INTC (1W: +41.48% | 1M: +114.09%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +34.06% | 1M: +39.45%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +13.55% | 1M: +33.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication lagging: CHTR (1W: -31.69% | 1M: -23.49%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -14.54% | 1M: -4.72%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Consumer Discretionary show weakness: FCX (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +41.48% | 1M: +114.09%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +34.06% | 1M: +39.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +16.10% | 1M: +74.26%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +13.55% | 1M: +33.82%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.30% | 1M: -1.66%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk flagged.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SYK (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -4.10%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -4.43% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND, MRK (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.24%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND, SHW (1W: -4.75% | 1M: +0.33%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Healthcare and Communication.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: INTC (1W: +41.48% | 1M: +114.09%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +34.06% | 1M: +39.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +16.10% | 1M: +74.26%) ABOVE TREND. Watch for major divergence: multiple megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, META, ORCL) show 1W vs 1M sign mismatches — tactical signals, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology: 18/24 positive (estimated breadth). Tech shows strength but mixed internals — INTC (1W: +41.48% | 1M: +114.09%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +34.06% | 1M: +39.45%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +14.43%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -7.17% | 1M: +6.95%) CORRECTION — leadership narrow, monitor large-cap divergences.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials: 12/20 positive (estimated breadth). JPM (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +7.03%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND — sector participation is healthy and supports rotation into cyclicals if leadership broadens.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare: 9/17 positive (estimated breadth). UNH (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +36.92%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +1.61%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -4.10%) BELOW TREND — mixed/defensive undercurrent, watch earnings/news flow.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Technology winners and Energy/Financial cyclicals (e.g., INTC, QCOM, GOOGL; MPC, VLO; JPM, V) while reducing exposure to lagging Communication names and stretched single-stock winners given narrow leadership. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt present but mixed internals and major divergence argue for selective exposure and active monitoring.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GOOGL (1W: +13.55% | 1M: +33.82%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +41.48% | 1M: +114.09%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +34.06% | 1M: +39.45%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -31.69% | 1M: -23.49%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -14.54% | 1M: -4.72%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -4.10%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (8/10 positive est.), Technology (18/24 positive est.), Financials (12/20 positive est.). BEARISH: Communication (3/10 positive est.), Materials (4/11 positive est.), Consumer Discretionary (5/14 positive est.).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch weekly trend holds and leadership breadth for regime confirmation: NVDA (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +14.43%) CORRECTION — weekly hold is key; GOOGL (1W: +13.55% | 1M: +33.82%) ABOVE TREND — follow breakout follow-through; JPM (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +7.03%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for continuation into cyclicals.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+80): General Dynamics (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND — price confirming upbeat Q1/upgrade. QCOM (+60): Qualcomm (1W: +34.06% | 1M: +39.45%) ABOVE TREND — earnings-driven surge confirming. MPC (+60): Marathon Petroleum (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +1.68%) ABOVE TREND — dividend/upgrade news confirming. VLO (+60): Valero (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND — earnings momentum confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
SYK (-55): Stryker (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -4.10%) BELOW TREND — earnings miss and price decline confirm. SHW (-50): Sherwin-Williams (1W: -4.75% | 1M: +0.33%) CORRECTION — negative commentary diverging from modest 1M gain, watch for follow-through. CHTR (-50): Charter (1W: -31.69% | 1M: -23.49%) BELOW TREND — earnings miss and sharp price decline confirm.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership. INTC, QCOM, GOOGL ABOVE TREND showing strength while NVDA, META, AAPL and MSFT exhibit short-term CORRECTION dynamics. Key risk: major-cap divergence and concentrated Tech leadership — monitor news-driven moves (CHTR, SYK) and breadth for regime confirmation.
